_note: USD per million tokens, list price (standard tier). Provider prices change: verify before relying on an estimate, and pass --prices <file> to override or add models. An entry may carry one prompt-length tier, `above`: {tokens, input, output}; a call whose input tokens are over `tokens` is priced at the `above` rates. A model with no entry here or in --prices makes the run refuse to start rather than be priced at zero. Matching is the exact id, or a dated snapshot of it (<id>-YYYYMMDD or <id>@...); any other variant is unpriced, including OpenAI's dashed-date snapshots (<id>-YYYY-MM-DD) and -pro/-mini variants. The ids bundled for each provider are listed under that provider's entry in `sources`, together with the page URL and the date the prices below were verified against it; supply any other provider or model with --prices.

anthropic.tier: Standard, text tokens, USD per 1M tokens
anthropic.caveat: claude-haiku-5-5 is priced by PROMPT LENGTH. Its entry carries both tiers: 0.1 / 0.5 per 1M tokens up to 100,000 input tokens, and an `above` tier of 0.5 / 2.5 for prompts over 100,000 tokens. Each call is priced at the tier its own input tokens fall in, in the pre-run estimate and in actual spend, so the estimate stays an upper bound for a large payload.
